profile_intent: DnB and bass-heavy material: preserve kick, snare, sub weight, bass punch, and transient motion while controlling harsh tops and side wash.
genre_rules: Preserve 45-140 Hz punch unless clipping or bloat is proven.
Control sub side energy before limiter movement becomes audible.
Use dynamic harsh-hat/snare control instead of broad top dulling.
Reject limiter-driven loudness when transient proxy or punch falls.
